newsitem.title: UK: South West Water up after UBS recommendation.
newsitem.headline: South West Water up after UBS recommendation.

text.p: Shares in South West Water defied weakness in the rest of the sector on Wednesday after UBS tipped it on Tuesday as one of nine mid-cap British stocks they expect to outperform in 1997, dealers said.
"Volume has been pretty slight but it seems to be up after the UBS tip," one market-maker said.

By 1237 GMT, South West Water shares were 15p higher at 622-1/2, although volume was just 109,539. Most other water utilities were either unchanged or weaker, with only Wessex Water gaining ground, up 1/2p at 382.
